description: Solar-grade polysilicon feedstock lot provenance + chain-of-custody attestation, emitted by the himawari polysilicon_refine cell (fed by supply_procurement). G2 (feedstock provenance on-chain per lot — NO XUAR/forced-labor polysilicon ever; no conflict-mineral In/Ga; full chain-of-custody CID-anchored) + §2(g) Charter Rider per-lot supply-chain audit structural enforcement — closes hikari §G2. Materializes into the kotoba Datom log (EAVT); each property is one attribute keyed by the record CID. solar-grade c-Si only (N1) — NOT the iwakura/fuigo/tsukuru logic-grade EG-Si track. Per ADR-2606021200.

lotId.description: himawari-assigned polysilicon feedstock lot identifier; root of the polysilicon → wafer → cell → module serial chain (G11 traceability)

recordedAt.description: attestation timestamp (ISO-8601); as-of point for the kotoba Datom history of this lot

feedstockGrade.description: solar-grade only; NOT logic-grade 9N+ EG-Si (N1 — separation from iwakura/fuigo/tsukuru fab)

process.description: refining route; fbr/umg-upgraded lower embodied energy (G4); recycled = kerf-Si circular loop (G5)

purityNines.description: metallurgical purity in 'nines' (6 = 6N solar-grade); >=9 would be logic-grade and is out of scope (N1)

supplierDid.description: DID of the feedstock supplier / refiner (own-cell or vetted upstream)

originRegionAttestationCid.description: G2/N6: XUAR-exclusion chain-of-custody; forced-labor-free origin-region attestation (content-addressed)

sourcingAuditCid.description: G2 §2(g) Charter Rider per-lot supply-chain audit (CID)

conflictMineralExclusionCid.description: N6: no conflict-mineral In/Ga in dopant/contact chemistry; exclusion attestation (CID)

chainOfCustody.description: G2 full quarry/MG-Si → polysilicon chain-of-custody, ordered earliest → latest; each hop CID-anchored

bomCid.description: G8: per-lot SBOM (CycloneDX → kotoba EAVT, ADR-2605312330); inputs + reagents for this lot

embodiedEnergyWhPerKg.description: G4 lifecycle energy accounting — embodied process energy (Wh per kg; integer)

renewableEnergyFractionBps.description: G4: fraction of refining energy from hikari renewable, basis points 0-10000 (10000 = 100%; fossil/nuclear prohibited at any tier)

attestingEngineerDid.description: DID of the PV-process engineer attesting this lot (Council technical-advisory member at R1 activation)

attestingRobots.description: Ed25519 robot witness quorum (>=2 distinct robots) over the lot QA + provenance bundle

custodyHop.description: One chain-of-custody hop in the quarry → polysilicon feedstock path (G2). Ordered position is the array index in the parent record.

stage.description: supply-chain stage; kerf-recovery = circular recycled loop (G5)

custodianDid.description: DID of the entity holding custody at this stage

regionCode.description: ISO-3166 region; G2 XUAR/forced-labor exclusion is evaluated against this

evidenceCid.description: content-addressed evidence for this hop (cert / audit / shipping doc)

robotSignature.description: G7-coupled Ed25519 robot witness attestation. Robot DID lineage logged so automated-away human QA tasks are accountable to the Liberation Metric (ADR-2605261000).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the attested lot bundle
